completion_promises.criterion_text: README.md has a "KV Stores" section (or dedicated docs/kv-usage.md)
completion_promises.evidence: Created dedicated docs/kv-usage.md with comprehensive KV documentation. Updated README.md KV Buckets section to include storage type and history depth columns, added cross-reference link to docs/kv-usage.md, and added the doc to the Docs index section.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Each bucket documented with purpose, TTL, storage type, history depth
completion_promises.evidence: Both README.md and docs/kv-usage.md contain a full reference table with columns for bucket name, key pattern, TTL, storage type (file/memory), history depth, max value size, and description. docs/kv-usage.md additionally includes a Configuration Rationale section explaining the design decisions for each bucket's settings.

completion_promises.criterion_text: CLI examples for nats kv get, nats kv put, nats kv watch
completion_promises.evidence: docs/kv-usage.md includes a comprehensive CLI Operations section with copy-pasteable examples for: put (all 4 buckets), get (all 4 buckets), delete, list all keys, view bucket info, and view key history. Each command includes realistic JSON payloads matching the documented value schemas.

docs/kv-usage.md contains a full Agent Interaction Patterns section with 4 detailed subsections, one per bucket. Each subsection includes: writer/reader roles, ASCII sequence diagram showing the interaction flow, key format, value schema (JSON), lifecycle steps, and relevant CLI commands.

completion_promises.criterion_text: agent-status: agent puts status on startup/heartbeat, dashboard watches
completion_promises.evidence: Section '1. agent-status: Online/Offline Heartbeat' documents the full lifecycle: agent puts status on startup, heartbeats every 30s, puts offline on shutdown. Dashboard watches for real-time updates. Includes sequence diagram, value schema with status/pid/started_at/last_heartbeat fields, and status values (online, offline, busy, draining).

completion_promises.criterion_text: agent-registry: agent puts manifest on register, Jarvis watches for changes
completion_promises.evidence: Section '2. agent-registry: Capability Manifests' documents: agent puts capability manifest on registration, Jarvis watches for routing table updates. Includes sequence diagram showing registration, capability update, and deregistration flows. Documents the capability manifest schema with agent_id, capabilities array, status, queue_depth, max_concurrent, and registered_at. Notes history=5 for rollback capability.

completion_promises.criterion_text: pipeline-state: pipeline service puts state transitions, dashboard reads
completion_promises.evidence: Section '3. pipeline-state: Feature Pipeline Tracking' documents: pipeline service puts state on each transition, dashboard/CLI reads current state via get. Includes sequence diagram, value schema with feature_id/state/wave/tasks fields, state values (planning, implementing, testing, reviewing, complete, failed), and notes 7-day TTL auto-cleanup and history=3 for transition tracking.

completion_promises.criterion_text: jarvis-session: Jarvis puts session context, reads on resume
completion_promises.evidence: Section '4. jarvis-session: Conversation Context' documents: Jarvis puts session context on each turn, reads on session resume. Includes sequence diagram showing create/read/update/expire lifecycle. Documents memory-backed storage rationale (ephemeral, high write throughput), 1-hour TTL auto-cleanup, and value schema with session_id/user/intent/context fields.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Watch pattern explained with example output
completion_promises.evidence: docs/kv-usage.md contains a dedicated 'Watch Pattern' section explaining: how nats kv watch subscribes to real-time change notifications, commands for watching all keys vs specific keys, and a realistic example output showing timestamped PUT and DEL operations across multiple agents. The section also explains that watchers receive initial state on startup (all existing key values), then stream subsequent changes.
